summary: First testing pass for Ian's 3D portfolio. Backend (FastAPI + Mongo) and frontend (React + R3F) tested end-to-end. 11/11 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend renders all sections, no runtime error overlay during navigation, EN/FR locale toggle works and persists across reloads, contact form submits successfully and POST /api/contact returns 201.

issues: locale-en / locale-fr buttons do not set aria-pressed attribute; consider adding aria-pressed for a11y. Not blocking.

action_items: Optional: add aria-pressed to locale toggle buttons in Navbar for screen-reader users.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is small and clean; MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection ({"_id": 0}).
Pydantic v2 EmailStr + length validators correctly trigger 422 responses.
Contact list returns most-recent first as required (verified ordering descending by created_at).
Note: backend has a legacy /api/status route - acceptable, kept from boilerplate.
Frontend: typing animation on hero-title means automated tests must use stable elements (e.g., about-title) to verify locale switching.
test_credentials: N/A - no authentication in this app
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed contact messages created during pytest run (test_ian_reviewer@example.com, test_nolocale@example.com) plus a Playwright contact (playwright_ian@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py covers health, contact CRUD-ish flow, validation, ordering and limit. Frontend verified: 4 canvases render (Hero R3F, About globe, Skills orb cloud, Contact particles), all 5 project cards, 4 experience items, 16 skill tags, EN/FR toggle (compare about-title not hero-title which uses typing animation), and contact POST returns 201 with contact-success toast.
rca of the issue: N/A - no new bugs found. Previous R3F x-line-number runtime error from @emergentbase/visual-edits is no longer observed; the patched RESERVED_PROPS guard in @react-three/fiber works during navigation across all sections.
